description: Run-directory naming contract: the readable stem is the run id reduced to [A-Za-z0-9._-] with a leading dot or dash replaced by an underscore, at most 48 characters, followed by '-' and the first 12 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of the original id. The directory is a locator only; the runId inside the events stays authoritative.

cases.note: a plain identifier keeps its readable form
dots are allowed inside the name
underscores are allowed
separators become underscores
a traversal attempt becomes a plain name
a backslash traversal attempt becomes a plain name
a leading dot becomes an underscore
two dots alone become a plain name
colons become underscores
collides with the next two on the readable stem; the hash keeps them apart
same readable stem as run/a
same readable stem as run/a
a drive-letter path becomes a plain name
an absolute path becomes a plain name
a long identifier keeps only the first 48 characters of its stem
the maximum-length identifier
a typical configured run id
a generated run id
a leading dash becomes an underscore so the name is never read as an option
dashes alone become a plain name
a single unsafe character becomes an underscore
an empty stem (not a valid protocol identifier, but reachable through the SDK helper) becomes an underscore
